hooks.command: crabswarm hook exec 'crabswarm chat report-state working' '{{/* records nothing, so a failed report never blocks a turn */}}'
crabswarm hook exec 'crabswarm chat report-state waiting' '{{/* records nothing, so a failed report never blocks a turn */}}'
crabswarm hook exec 'crabswarm chat report-state done' '{{/* records nothing, so a failed report never blocks a turn */}}'
crabswarm hook exec 'crabswarm chat report-state waiting' '{{/* records nothing, so a failed report never blocks a turn */}}'

crabswarm hook exec 'crabswarm chat read --quiet' '{{if and .Success .Stdout}}{{context (printf "[crabswarm chat] Messages just arrived. Reply with `crabswarm chat send <name|team/name> <text>` if any is addressed to you; otherwise carry on.\n\n%s" .Stdout)}}{{end}}'
crabswarm hook exec 'crabswarm chat report-state working' '{{/* records nothing, so a failed report never blocks a turn */}}'

crabswarm hook exec '{{if .Input.StopHookActive}}crabswarm chat report-state done{{else}}crabswarm chat read --quiet --done-when-empty{{end}}' '{{if and .Success .Stdout}}{{blockDecision (printf "[crabswarm chat] Messages arrived while you were working. Act on anything addressed to you, reply with `crabswarm chat send <name|team/name> <text>`, then finish.\n\n%s" .Stdout)}}{{end}}'
